title: Finite Contact Theory v0.1: Growing the Bell/CHSH Quantum Boundary from a Finite One-Use Floor
description: A finite reconstruction program for admissible reality, starting below spacetime, probability, observers, Hilbert space, and the completed continuum. This v0.1 chapter grows the Bell/CHSH quantum boundary from a finite one-use floor at binary-Bell finite-carrier scope: witness counting, one-receiver gluing, rational Born weights, the CHSH/Pell boundary, and a native binary-Bell carrier grammar, each carrying an explicit status label and scope fence, with a shipped dependency-free verification subset and a public correction ledger. Every generalization beyond binary-Bell finite-carrier scope - the general quantum selector, q>=3 carriers, cross-site interlocking, gravity sourcing, and nature-facing predictions - is held open by name. This is the first published chapter of a larger reconstruction program.
